messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT [P1] routing anomalies detected in eu-west. Trigger: fallback_rate=23% (5m). Pager: @anne_oncall
anne_oncall: I'm oncall — joining. what's current impact? :phone:
mike_sre: looking... pulling routing metrics and recent deploys
latency-monitor-bot: alert snapshot: 09:42 - latency jump; 09:43 - fallback spike; 09:46 - partial spillover to eu-central
ravi_infra: pulling router logs now. grepping for 'FALLBACK' across router fleet. here's a tail sample:
```
[09:43:12] router-17: decision=FALLBACK model=fallback-model-v1 reason=kv_miss
[09:43:15] router-09: decision=FALLBACK model=fallback-model-v2 reason=timeout
[09:43:18] router-21: decision=FALLBACK model=fallback-model-v1 reason=queue_full
```
emily_prod: Support: 3 enterprise customers (Astra, ElmHealth, FastShip) reported 504/timeout between 09:44-09:48. attaching brief logs from ElmHealth
john_support: ElmHealth ticket created: https://support.redwood/tickets/INC12345 — sample request ID rwd-9a3f attached in ticket
mike_sre: preliminary hypothesis 1: primary model pool in eu-west hit resource contention (OOMs/timeouts) -> many requests fell back. fallback-model-v2 wasn't fully compatible with current routing tier which produced misroutes and timeouts
ravi_infra: hypothesis 2: recent routing policy change at ~09:40 (weight adjustments) created uneven distribution and overloaded a subset of routers. checking policy commits now
anne_oncall: Can we confirm whether a policy change was applied at 09:40? If yes, consider rolling back and observe.
emily_prod: Confirmed: policy commit by emily_prod at 09:39: "adjust weight for spillover" (PR #482). Noted in change log.
mike_sre: mitigation idea: pin VIP customers to alternative region / dedicated capacity and increase request timeouts temporarily. Trying for Astra now.
mike_sre: mitigation command (executed):
```
# pin Astra to eu-central until eu-west stabilizes
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/routes/pin -d '{"customer":"Astra","region":"eu-central","reason":"mitigation"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
mike_sre: Astra pinned. monitoring traffic shift.
latency-monitor-bot: metric update (1m): fallback_rate -> 12% (from 23%), average latency down 18%
anne_oncall: good signal. Ravi — status on rolling back the policy commit?
ravi_infra: located commit. rolling back to previous policy now (applied at ~09:51).
ravi_infra: rollback applied. verifying router distributions...
mike_sre: routers starting to prefer primary model again. sample log after rollback:
```
[09:52:03] router-17: decision=PRIMARY model=redwood-4k reason=healthy
[09:52:04] router-09: decision=PRIMARY model=redwood-4k reason=healthy
```
john_support: ElmHealth confirms recovery in ticket INC12345 at ~09:54 — they report requests succeeding again
emily_prod: ETA to full recovery 10-15m. We should collect artifacts for RCA: policy diff, router traces, model pool metrics, customer tickets.
anne_oncall: Agreed. I'll open the RCA doc and assign owners. Suggested action items: timeline, logs, hypotheses, short-term mitigation, long-term fixes.
mike_sre: brief notes for RCA: add guardrail to block policy changes when fallback_rate > 10% in a region; add automated canary for policy commits that measure fallback selection impact in 1m buckets
ravi_infra: I'll upload router diagnostic bundles + commit diff to the RCA doc. link: https://docs.redwood/rca/1998234567 (draft created)
emily_prod: Customer impact list: Astra (ticket INC12346), ElmHealth (INC12345), FastShip (INC12347). John — please consolidate support tickets and any customer-visible messages.
john_support: on it. will attach timelines and sample request/response pairs.
anne_oncall: Owners and immediate follow-ups:
- timeline: mike_sre
- logs & kernel traces: ravi_infra
- customer impact: john_support + emily_prod
- policy review + product changes: emily_prod + product
- runbook updates: mike_sre
mike_sre: also recommend adding a synthetic check that verifies fallback-model compatibility for each routing tier after policy changes
latency-monitor-bot: Incident 1998234567 metric summary: peak fallback_rate 23%, duration ~16m
incident-bot: Incident 1998234567 marked as resolved by anne_oncall at 09:58. Duration 16m.
anne_oncall: thanks everyone — great coordination. We'll keep this thread for RCA drafts and postmortem notes. Follow-up sync scheduled 15:00 UTC to finalize RCA. :calendar:
